//: A security review traces the request parameter to the file path it escapes, and changes nothing.
title: The path traversal is traced from the request to the file, and nothing changes
proof:
cat <<'EVAL_EOF'
files.py:8: download() joins the name from the request onto UPLOADS, so name=../../etc/passwd reads any file: path traversal. Resolve the path and check it stays inside UPLOADS.
EVAL_EOF
